checks: PR maps to an authorized ticket
branch and scope match the authorized work
no unrelated cleanup or hidden feature work is included
implementation does not cross an unresolved decision trigger
no material architectural or product decision was invented in code
requirement meaning has not been silently changed
changed files are necessary for the ticket
no unnecessary framework or infrastructure is introduced
provider-specific structures do not leak beyond adapters
frontend does not own authoritative business logic
LLM responsibilities remain separated from deterministic logic
no silent fallback creates incorrect business results
unknown values are not converted to false certainty
unknown price is never treated as zero
arbitrary outbound URLs are not introduced
provider content is treated as untrusted
model output cannot bypass tool validation
public errors do not leak sensitive internals
unnecessary repeated provider/database work is avoided
change does not obviously violate target latency without justification
provider failures map to typed outcomes
partial failures do not corrupt authoritative data
duplicate execution does not create inconsistent state
cache/database writes are safe for expected concurrency
N/A is explicitly justified where the change is read-only and stateless
tests map to the implemented requirement
confirmed defects receive regression tests where practical
tests assert behavior rather than only implementation details

review_order.mandatory_question: Does another path exist that can bypass this control or reproduce the same defect?

checks: migration/release impact is identified where relevant
CURRENT_STATUS is updated when project state changes
decision documents are updated if decisions changed
PR is not recommended for merge with unresolved blocking findings
